special_rules.title: Profit share on positive A-book PnL and loss limits
special_rules.text: Applies to new accounts under Hive 2.0 (1 Dec 2025; the official X post said “Only updating new accounts”). January 2026 terms (checked via archive): profit share is on positive A-book PnL — NewBee 70%, WorkerBee 80% (QueenBee 90%). Max loss per trade 3%; balance-based daily loss NewBee 5%, WorkerBee 4% (QueenBee 3%); overall loss capped at 10% of balance. The live terms PDF on the official site (retrieved 18 Oct 2026) is the same January 2026 version with the same figures.
